programs.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programs.desc: A sous chef aboard a cruise ship leaves her shift unexpectedly and is never seen again; the pressure of the kitchen may have pushed her to take her own life, or maybe there was foul play; the clues could help solve the mystery.

programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: When bank employee Theodore Conrad casually walks off his job carrying hundreds of thousands of dollars in a paper bag, a fifty-two year manhunt ensues; two federal marshals and a father and son duo manage to close the case.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: A single father finally finds a love he can grow old with; but just months after they've wed, his retirement savings are depleted, and he learns he's only the latest in a string of victims; when he files for divorce, things get much worse.

programs.title: Heartland Homicide
programs.desc: A young police officer discovers the dark secret hidden in a neighborhood restaurant.

programs.title: Code of Misconduct
programs.desc: Inside a London, Ontario courtroom, journalist Rick Westhead bears witness as five former members of the 2018 Canadian World Junior hockey team stand trial, forcing a reckoning within Canada's national pastime.

programs.title: Seduced by His Lies
programs.desc: Terri returns from an extended trip to find a mysterious yet captivating stranger living in her recently purchased home. Believing they've been scammed, they team up to expose the criminals, only to uncover a chilling labyrinth of lies and deception.
